title: Twist E19: Indecomposable gluing, a genus-2 curve and explicit maps
status_note: Proposed E19; not started. Explicit gluing/polarization/model/map constructors and independent replay are missing. A separate runnable protocol and source/checker pins are required.
blocked_on: note:Explicit gluing/polarization/model/map constructors and independent replay are missing.
question: Does an E18 anti-isometry yield an indecomposably principally polarized quotient with an explicit same-field genus-2 model and subgroup transfer?
decision_value: A fully checked toy model becomes an E24 arithmetic input and a future destination-solver input. A failed anti-isometry closes only that candidate. P-521 construction success remains a public-parameter result, with no NIST DLP execution.

resources.notes: Proposed pilot: one CPU, 4 GiB and 3,600 seconds per anti-isometry. Stop that cell on a singular model, failed descent, failed map identity or resource cap; retain the failed certificate. Full resources remain unestimated. The nominal disk field is not an estimate; calibrate and freeze it before readiness.

outputs.result_schema: Not frozen; required evidence fields are in the linked design. No result exists.
